recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Wallis and Futuna Islands. Parliamentary democracy (territorial assembly); overseas collectivity of france.
rulers: President Emmanuel MACRON (since 14 May 2017); represented by Administrator Superior Jean-François de MANHEULLE (since 17 November 2025); President of the Territorial Assembly Munipoese MULI'AKA'AKA (since 20 March 2022)
government: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Assembly); overseas collectivity of France
economy: lower-middle-income, agrarian French dependency economy; heavily reliant on French subsidies; licenses fishing rights to Japan and South Korea; major remittances from New Caledonia; aging workforce; import-dependent; deforestation-fueled fragility
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
